brief: Licensed photograph of dated artefacts from the African Middle Stone Age (Mode 3): Levallois flakes and points, Still Bay bifacial points, Howiesons Poort backed blades; later Upper Palaeolithic blades and microliths: Levallois flakes and points; Still Bay bifacial leaf points (about 75,000 years ago, Blombos); Howiesons Poort backed blades (about 65,000 years ago); bone points and awls (organic; Blombos). Search terms: Still Bay point Blombos | Howiesons Poort backed blade | Jebel Irhoud Levallois flake | Middle Stone Age point Klasies River.
